integrity: The proof is a self-contained character-orthogonality and local-valuation argument; the included finite-field checker is corroborative. Historical priority has only been compared against specified accessible material. No independent audit or validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns odd prime base fields, the unnormalized conic self-restriction matrix, and Smith invariants localized at the cyclotomic prime over the field characteristic. It does not yield Archimedean singular values, integer Smith factors, all minors, even characteristic, or extension-field classifications; finite checks do not prove all-prime quantifiers. A broader preexisting p-adic exponential-sum valuation theorem might imply these invariants.
title: Local Smith invariants and self-Fourier uniqueness for prime-field norm-one conics
